In a sense, Baahi is a name that inspires individuals to be a source of happiness in the lives of others.

It is also a reminder of the emotional and spiritual richness that comes from living a life of devotion and service to Allah and His creation. Ultimately, the name Baahi is a reminder of the power of love, kindness, and joy to bring us closer to Allah and to inspire us to live a life of purpose and meaning.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Abd al-Hakam's 'Futuh Misr' (The Conquest of Egypt), written in 872 AD, mentions a certain 'Baahi' son of 'Asad' who was the governor of Alexandria during the caliphate of Al-Mu'tasim. Baahi is known for his piety and his efforts to spread Islamic knowledge in Egypt.
